definitions.title: Cylinder
definitions.statement: A cylinder is a surface generated by a straight line (the generatrix) moving parallel to a fixed given line while intersecting a fixed plane curve (the generating curve or directrix).
conditions: Generating curve is in a coordinate plane
definitions.explanation: Equations missing one variable in 3D represent cylinders whose rulings are parallel to the axis of the missing variable.
definitions.keyTakeaway: In 3D, x^2 + y^2 = 1 represents a circular cylinder along the z-axis, not just a circle.

definitions.title: Quadric Surfaces Classification
definitions.latex: A x^2 + B y^2 + C z^2 + D xy + E yz + F xz + G x + H y + I z + J = 0
definitions.statement: A quadric surface is the graph of a second-degree polynomial equation in three variables. By translation and rotation, every non-degenerate quadric surface reduces to an ellipsoid, elliptic/hyperbolic paraboloid, cone, or hyperboloid of one or two sheets.
conditions: At least one second-degree coefficient is non-zero
definitions.explanation: Analyzed by examining 2D cross-sections (traces) formed by intersections with planes parallel to coordinate planes.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Quadric surfaces are 3D counterparts of 2D conic sections.
